reviews.title: Previous Review Addendum
reviews.text: I already left a negative review about this new stats rollout and it's inaccuracy and the annoyance it's caused me, but I have something else to say now that I see one of the goals you can set for your ai coach to track is "lose weight." YOU ARE NOT A CALORIE TRACKING APP. It is undoubtedly dishonest to give users a score for losing weight when missing the biggest piece of the puzzle: diet. I understand consistency changes the metabolic rate but you cannot out-train a bad diet no matter how intense or consistent you are. It would be much better served as one of the benefits you can unlock rather than a flat score that's making promises it cannot keep.

reviews.title: Horrible Greedy Company
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal Arrow Fitness user from the very first day, and the most recent update completely destroyed my trust in the app.

In September 2025, I paid for a full year of the Gold subscription because it was the highest tier available for $35 and included full access. Before my one-year subscription even expired, the developers introduced a new “Diamond” tier and moved features I had already paid for behind another paywall.

Instead of honoring the subscription I purchased for the full year, they effectively downgraded my active subscription and expected me to pay another $60 to get back the functionality I originally bought.

Changing your pricing model is one thing. Taking away benefits from customers who already paid for a year is another. Existing annual subscribers should have been grandfathered in until their subscription expired.

After years of supporting this app, I feel completely misled. I won’t be renewing, and I can’t recommend paying for any long-term subscription if the terms can change before it ends.

When this app came out a few years ago I absolutely loved it. It was simple, free, and worked well. So when they came out with gold access I was more than happy to support a solid app. But terminating users access early when they had already prepaid in full, and then putting a higher paywall above that existing access is something I will not stand for. 

I highly recommend you dont download this app, you cant even use it without signing up for a trial. Not what it used to be. They lost a loyal customer that has been here from the very first day it launched pre-access on the app store. Horribly dissatisfied and disappointed.

reviews.title: Weekly Quests
reviews.text: This app records your PRs, volume lifted, what muscles you’ve activated, your progress over time on a certain movement, etc. It’s great but I think a good QOL update to this app would be removing cardio as a requirement to finish all your weekly quests. This is because you must have a membership to log an activity which is apart of the weekly quests, so I don’t think it’s fair for the weekly feature to be locked behind a pay wall. A good way to counter this would be making it free to log an activity or to allow you to reroll certain things in the weekly quest so you can finish them without paying money. Thanks.
